queries: WITH matched AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, s.optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg), overall AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS overall_avg FROM matched), pairs AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) AS pair_avg FROM matched GROUP BY transref, tradekind), deviations AS (SELECT p.*, p.pair_avg - o.overall_avg AS deviation FROM pairs AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL), type_averages AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) AS type_avg_deviation FROM deviations WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT d.tradekind, AVG(d.pair_avg) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(d.deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(d.deviation - a.type_avg_deviation) AS avg_excess FROM deviations AS d JOIN type_averages AS a ON d.tradekind = a.tradekind WHERE d.deviation > a.type_avg_deviation GROUP BY d.tradekind
